I have enough understanding. Let me analyze the bug.

The issue: `has_select_fields` checks `self.select or self.annotation_select_mask or self.extra_select_mask`. When `alias()` is used after `annotate()`, the annotation is moved to `annotations` but removed from `annotation_select_mask` (set to empty set). So `has_select_fields` returns False, and `RelatedIn.get_prep_lookup` calls `clear_select_clause()` which wipes the select clause, then adds only the target field — but the annotations remain in `self.annotations`, so the subquery selects 10 columns.

Let me check the QuerySet.alias implementation to confirm.
